core_doctrine: Compensation for Loss or Damage Caused by Breach
story_summary: A factory owner suffers ₹2,00,000 in idle-time losses after a machinery supplier fails to deliver on time, triggering the rules of natural vs. remote damages.

scenes.dialogue: Namaskaram! Nammal innu padikkan pokunnath Section 73 aanu. Mr. Rajesh thante factory-ilekku puthiya machinery supply cheyyan vendi SuperMech Ltd-umayi oru agreement-il elpetu. Ee contract prakaram machinery krithyam samayathu delivery cheyyanam ennu vyakthamayi paranjittundu.

lines.sentence: Mr. Rajesh enters into a formal Commercial Supply Agreement with SuperMech Ltd for industrial machinery.
Both parties expressed Free Consent and consensus on the terms of the machinery specifications.

scenes.dialogue: Pakshe, SuperMech krithyam samayathu machinery deliver cheythilla. Ithumoolam factory-ile production thadanju. Direct result ayi factory idle time moolam Rajesh-inu ₹2,00,000 nashtam sambhavichu. Ithanu nammude Breach of Contract.

lines.sentence: The supplier defaulted on the delivery, causing an immediate halt in factory production.

action_payload.cause: Failure to deliver machinery per schedule

lines.sentence: Due to this breach, Mr. Rajesh suffered a quantified direct loss of ₹2,00,000 for factory idle time.

quadrants.title: Natural Losses
quadrants.body: Losses that naturally arose in the usual course of things.

quadrants.title: Known Losses
quadrants.body: Losses known to parties when making the contract.

quadrants.title: No Remote Loss
quadrants.body: Compensation is NOT given for indirect or remote damages.

quadrants.title: Duty to Mitigate
quadrants.body: Must take steps to remedy the inconvenience caused.

scenes.dialogue: Ini namukku Section 73-inte niyamangal nokkam. Oru contract break cheythal, compensation kittan 4 main conditions undu. Onnu, nashtam 'naturally arose' aayirikkanam. Allenkil parties-inu munkootti ariyunna 'likely result' aayirikkanam. Remote aaya nashtangal kuttan pattilla.

lines.sentence: Section 73 mandates that only losses arising naturally in the usual course are recoverable.

scenes.dialogue: Ivide factory idle time nashtam direct nashtamanu, athu kittum. Pakshe ee machinery vannirunnenkil vere oru export order kitti valiya labham undakumayirunnu ennu Rajesh paranjaal, athu 'remote loss' aanu. Section 73 anganulla remote nashtangale support cheyyilla.

lines.sentence: The law balances direct losses from the breach against unpredictable, remote consequential damages.

scenes.dialogue: Section 73-ile ettavum pradhanappetta oru karyam 'Mitigation' aanu. Contract break cheythal nashtam kuraykkanulla ellam vazhikalum Mr. Rajesh nokkanam. Kayyil ulla options upayogichu nashtam minimse cheythillel court compensation kuraykkum.

lines.sentence: In estimating the loss, the court accounts for the means which existed of remedying the inconvenience.

scenes.dialogue: Section 73-inte mooladhara case 'Hadley v. Baxendale' aanu. Ee case-ilaanu first time 'Natural' and 'Contemplated' damages enna concept konduvannathu. Indian Contract Act Section 73 poornamaayum ee ratio base cheythulla aanu.

lines.sentence: The court held that damages are only recoverable if they are natural or within the contemplation of the parties.

action_payload.ratio: Damages should be those which may fairly and reasonably be considered as arising naturally from such breach.
